children: Guggenheim on Wednesday upgraded Editas Medicine
to Buy from Neutral, arguing that the company’s hyperlipidemia therapy, EDIT-401, represents a novel gene editing approach for severely high blood cholesterol.
Analyst Debjit Chattopadhyay’s upgrade comes as Editas
prepares to initiate a Phase 1/2 clinical trial for EDIT-401 in heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia by the end of 2026, with a data update

Chattopadhyay cites a niche market for the one-time therapy in patients with atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease and severely high LDL-C, also known as "bad" cholesterol, should its clinical data confirm the efficacy and acceptable safety profile shown in preclinical trials.

“EDIT-401 activity is largely restricted to the liver, limiting potential impacts on other tissues, but data on potential off-target edits remain outstanding,” the analyst wrote based on its study data from nonhuman primates.
Chattopadhyay’s rating decision and $5 price target for EDIT assume a 30% probability of success for EDIT-401 but no revenue estimates for the company’s other pipeline assets.

title: Editas raised to Buy at Guggenheim on cholesterol therapy
